title: Chapter 253 Don'T Know Him
content:
Chapter 253 Don'T Know Him

At this time, Xun Heng stood up in the center of the Taiwan Central Committee and then shouted: "Next, my alchemist in the desert city, Master Slayer, will appear, let us have applause!"

Xun Heng's voice was extremely loud and soon spread throughout the deserted city.

For a moment, the lively atmosphere present was briefly quiet for a moment.

However, the next moment, the roaring applause rang like thunder.

"Master Killing!Master Killing!!!"

"Ah! I'm so excited!!"

Countless people in the audience roared wildly and screamed excitedly.

The entire deserted city was filled with cheering sounds at this moment.

The corner of the audience.

Tan Songci frowned slightly.

Master Killing?

Who is this? Why don’t you remember me?

At this time, Bai Lushuang slowly walked to Tan Songci and asked respectfully: "Master Tan, who is this Master Killer, and why has the students never heard of it?"

Hearing Bai Lushuang’s questions, the other students of the academy also looked over, their eyes full of confusion.

Seeing everyone staring at him, Tan Songci was speechless.

"This, maybe some hidden master."

There is only one possibility.

After all, not all talented people in the fairyland will choose to appear in the eyes of the world.

Some prefer a clean environment and study hard alone.

Such people are often even more terrifying.

Upon hearing this, Bai Lushuang and others nodded slightly.

They were just curious.

At this time, a student said, "Teacher, let's just ask."

So many people were cheering and shouting. Obviously, this Master Killing is very famous, maybe they just don’t know.

Immediately, the student slowly stepped forward and photographed a man who was shouting wildly.

"Brother, I have a question below. I wonder who Master Slayer is. Is he more famous than Master Qiao?"

Hearing this question, the man was slightly stunned, then shook his head and said, "I don't know you either, but everyone is shouting, so I shouted with you."

After all, the atmosphere is over.

It’s a bit unreasonable not to shout.

After saying that, the man turned his head and continued to shout.

Standing there, the student was obviously a little confused.

What is the reason for this?

And Tan Songci and others also heard the man's words.

Everyone couldn't help but twitch their mouths.

On stage.

Xun Heng looked at the atmosphere below and felt very satisfied.

It's worth it. I've tried my best to invite so many extras.

I believe the city lord’s wife and Lord Wan must be very satisfied.

At the same time, an old man in an ink robe slowly walked into the stage surrounded by several people from the deserted city.

Kill the Refining Heaven!

The alchemist in the deserted city is also the only one.

I saw that the image of Shi Liantian had undergone earth-shaking changes at this moment.

The ragged clothes that looked like beggars had already faded away, and the dirty old face had also recovered, and the whole person was suddenly refreshed.

Even a faint heroic spirit slowly overflowed from Shi Liantian's face.

Obviously, Shi Liantian is really stocked.

He must have been a handsome man with high spirits.

At this moment, everyone was staring at Shi Liantian.

But without exception, no one can recognize it.

Shi Liantian does not belong to this era, nor does it belong to the previous era, and may even be earlier.

Even some old monsters present from the fairyland were frowning.

Who is this?

On the other side of the stage, Jordanyang looked at Shi Liantian who had changed his shape, and for some reason, he became a little nervous.

And at this moment, the scene suddenly began to vibrate slightly.

Buzz —

I saw that the entire alchemy competition platform began to extend wildly.

No, it's not just a competition.

The entire square began to change at this moment.

Everyone was shocked and looked at the square under their feet with horror.

After just a moment, the space in the entire square increased by hundreds of times.

The crowded environment present also became spacious instantly.

At the same time, the huge alchemy competition platform is located at the bottom, and the square is in the shape of an inverted triangle.

It makes it more convenient for the audience to watch.

"This relationship is good."

"Good, it looks much more comfortable."

"Hey, look!"

In the crowd, one of them pointed at the air position on the competition stand and saw a hazy small space floating there.

Several blurry figures sat inside, looking down at the lower body with a calm expression.

"Damn, that location is great."

"Okay, okay, it's good, but that's what people do in Huangcheng. Can you sit on it?"

And this is right.

At this moment, in the hazy small space, Lu Xue, Gu Chen, An Xing and others were sitting there, looking at the bottom.

Next to Lu Xue, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng were also sitting here.

"Hey, Sister Xue, look! Isn't that that person?"

Xiao Luo pointed to a position below.

Lu Xue and the others looked in the direction and immediately saw Bai Lushuang and others.

"Huh? Mentor Tan is here too?!"

Qin Feng was surprised.

Unexpectedly, Mentor Tan actually came too.

Immediately, Qin Feng quickly glanced at the scene, but after watching it for several rounds, he didn't see what he wanted to see.

"Oh, that's right, how could the teacher come to see the alchemy competition?"

Qin Feng murmured to himself and shook his head slightly.

Lu Xue looked at Bai Lushuang and others below, with expressionless faces.

"What do they have to do with me? No matter them."

Lu Xue spoke in a faint voice.

Hearing this, Qin Feng and Xiao Luo didn't say anything. Obviously, they were very concerned about the last time that Bai Lushuang drove Lu Xue out of the alchemy club.

At this moment, Lu Xue could use her own way to cure her body and drive Bai Lushuang out of here.

As the daughter of the lord of Huangcheng City, she has full power.

But Lu Xue did not do so.

Not far away, An Xing saw the movements of Lu Xue and others, and his eyes immediately flowed, not knowing what he was thinking.

After a moment of silence, An Xing stood up and came to Lu Xue, and whispered: "Miss, I have something to deal with."

Here, Lu Xue has the highest status.

So An Xing felt it was necessary to ask for instructions.

Hearing this, Lu Xue was stunned and smiled and said, "It's okay, you're busy with yours."

An Xing nodded, then his figure flashed, and turned into a black shadow, instantly disappeared from the spot.

On the side of Lu Xue, Qin Feng and Xiao Luo looked at each other, with shock in their eyes.

Even if they just approached slightly, the two of them felt a very uncomfortable feeling.

That guy is very dangerous.

Obviously, the two of them had a good intuition.

An Xing, who had just disappeared into the small space, appeared in the dark outside the square the next moment.

At this moment, An Xing's deep eyes were staring at Tan Songci and others, especially Bai Lushuang.

At this moment, a black shadow appeared beside An Xing.

"Sir, please give me instructions."
